task_completion.description: Open the Weasis application and load the DICOM series from the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis interface is visible with the DICOM series (0002.DCM) loaded in the explorer or main view.

task_completion.description: Configure the layout to show at least three panels in a grid.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The main viewing area is divided into at least three distinct image panels/viewports.

task_completion.description: Display the same DICOM series in at least three separate panels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Three separate panels are populated with the same image series.

task_completion.description: Apply distinct Window/Level settings (Soft Tissue, Bone, Lung) to each of the three panels.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The three panels show the same image but with clearly different contrast/brightness levels (one dark/high contrast for bone, one balanced for soft tissue, one optimized for air/lung).

task_completion.description: Save a screenshot of the multi-window setup to the specified export path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file browser or terminal command confirms the creation of 'trauma_layout.png' in ~/DICOM/exports/.

task_completion.description: Record the WC and WW values for all three panels in the specified text file format.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows 'window_levels.txt' containing three lines of 'Panel X: WC [value], WW [value]'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to configure the layout and window levels rather than just creating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Weasis layout menus and Window/Level sliders or presets.

integrity.description: The WC/WW values recorded in the text file match the values visible in the Weasis UI overlays.
integrity.visual_evidence: The text in window_levels.txt matches the 'W' and 'C' (or WW/WL) values displayed in the corner of each respective panel in the GUI.

integrity.description: The panels are unlinked, allowing for different views of the same series.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UI shows that 'Sync' or 'Link' properties are disabled, or the visual contrast differs between panels despite them showing the same frame.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task uses a real DICOM file (0002.DCM) which is an X-Ray Angiography (XA) image, though the task refers to it as a trauma CT. The agent must produce exactly 3 distinct WC/WW pairs. The expected output files are /home/ga/DICOM/exports/trauma_layout.png and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/window_levels.txt. Verify that the WC/WW values in the text file correspond to the visual appearance of Bone, Soft Tissue, and Lung presets in the Weasis interface.
